_README: Who the player can be. Four main characters, one chosen at New Game.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
never overwrites it and the canon workbook has no tab for it.
ALL FOUR ARE PLACEHOLDERS. CLAUDE.md lists the protagonist's identity and
party as an open decision. PC01 keeps the stand-in Cameron chose earlier
(Hiro, Frontier Party - Frontier Party is canon, it is OP02 Yuriko
Mayeda's party). PC02-PC04 are neutral stand-ins with no party, so
nothing here invents a character or a party. Replace them freely.
FIELDS, per protagonist:
player_id   PC01-PC04. Also the art ID and the speech ID:
assets/characters/protagonists/PC01_neutral.png, and
sounds.json's speech table under "PC01".
name_en     Shown on the Office and the New Game screen.
name_jp     Optional small accent beside it.
party       The caucus is this party's caucus ({party} in stage names).
Blank means the stage is just called "Caucus".
blurb       One or two lines for the New Game screen. Blank is fine.
default_protagonist is who you are before anyone has been chosen - the
tests, and the browser playtest, which has no New Game screen.
The party matters mechanically later: the workbook note on MOD01 seq 3
says the Caucus rival should be replaced with a same-party opponent once
the protagonist's party is settled.
